js: JavaScript was originally created in just 10 days.
Despite the name, JavaScript is not related to Java.
NaN is a special numeric value in JavaScript that literally means Not-a-Number.
The first word many JavaScript developers learn is console.log.
css: CSS stands for Cascading Style Sheets.
The cascade part of CSS decides which rule wins when multiple rules target the same element.
You can animate many CSS properties using the transition property.
The CSS box model is the foundation of how elements are sized and spaced.
